name: Camille Fabron
headline: Senior Product Manager
summary: Senior Product Manager with 9 years of experience driving product strategy and growth for B2B and B2C digital platforms. Skilled in leveraging data-driven insights, A/B testing, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver measurable business impact. Proven track record of leading product teams from discovery to launch in fast-paced environments.

responsibilities: Define and own product strategy for a SaaS analytics platform serving mid-market clients
Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and data analysts
Design and analyze A/B tests to optimize onboarding funnel conversion
Use SQL to extract and interpret user behavior data for roadmap prioritization
Present quarterly business reviews to executive stakeholders
Managed the product lifecycle for a mobile marketplace application
Conducted user interviews and synthesized findings into actionable product requirements
Ran A/B tests on checkout flow to improve conversion rates
Collaborated with engineering to prioritize backlog based on data insights
Partnered with marketing on go-to-market strategies for new features
Supported senior PMs in defining product requirements and user stories
Analyzed customer feedback and usage data to identify improvement opportunities
Assisted in coordinating sprint planning and release cycles with engineering teams
Created wireframes and prototypes for new feature concepts
